about_the_game:
The King craves treasures, and YOU are the miner tasked with finding them. Dig up the riches, and survive the dangers of the mine!

MINE

Dig through the mine to find different kinds of ores, each worth a different amount. From simple copper to rare adamant, everything can be sold to make money!

GEAR UP

Upgrade your tools to become a better miner! Buy stronger equipment to dig deeper, mine faster, and uncover the rarest treasures hidden underground.

OVERCOME

Beware of the dangers lurking in the mine! Face off against goblins, spiders, and other threats as you dig deeper. Stay alert, or risk losing your hard-earned treasures.

TRIBUTE

Keep the King happy by delivering treasures to him before his patience runs out! Complete tributes to earn his favor and receive random magical items as a reward for your loyalty.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • Fully single-player experience: no online requirements, no microtransactions, and no planned DLCs.

  • Casual mining gameplay: each run lasts between 5 to 30 minutes, depending on your playstyle.

  • Procedurally generated mine: every run features a new mine layout.

  • Persistent hub & metaprogression: upgrade the Throne Room and improve your standing with the King and the Miners Guild over multiple runs.

  • Mine 4 different types of ore: Copper, Silver, Gold, and Adamant, each with unique value.

  • Multiple win conditions: 3 distinct ways to complete a run, each offering its own challenge and rewards.

  • Upgradeable mining gear: 5 different tools to enhance your mining efficiency.

  • Magic items: 8 unique magic items that grant powerful effects.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: 64 bit CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2020
  • Processor: 64 bit CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 64 bit CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with Vulkan 1.0 support

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 64 bit CPU with SSE4.2 instructions, with 4 physical cores or more
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
